name: Parafluorofuranylfentanyl
summary: para-Fluorofuranylfentanyl (FFF, p-F-Fu-F) is an opioid analgesic that is an analog of fentanyl and has been sold as a designer drug. As with other fentanyl analogues, parafluorofuranylfentanyl has significant side effects including itching, nausea and potentially serious respiratory depression, which can be life-threatening, and it has been linked to numerous deaths from overdose.

uses.text: para-Fluorofuranylfentanyl (FFF, p-F-Fu-F) is an opioid analgesic that is an analog of fentanyl and has been sold as a designer drug.

pharmacology.en: It is an agonist at the μ-opioid receptor, the same target as fentanyl and morphine, and its effects can be reversed by naloxone.
pharmacology.zh: 它是 μ 型鴉片受體的促效劑，與吩坦尼和嗎啡的作用目標相同，其作用可被納洛酮逆轉。
pharmacology.zhHans: 它是 μ 型鸦片受体的促效剂，与吩坦尼和吗啡的作用目标相同，其作用可被纳洛酮逆转。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its class, the opioids, cause drowsiness, nausea, constipation and slowed breathing, and an overdose can stop breathing altogether. Fentanyl analogues are very potent, so overdose is a serious risk.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。它所屬的鴉片類藥物會造成嗜睡、噁心、便祕與呼吸變慢，過量時可能導致呼吸完全停止。吩坦尼類似物藥效極強，過量的風險很高。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。它所属的鸦片类药物会造成嗜睡、恶心、便秘与呼吸变慢，过量时可能导致呼吸完全停止。吩坦尼类似物药效极强，过量的风险很高。

fact.en: It stacks two modifications on fentanyl at once: a fluorine on the ring and a furan ring, an oxygen-containing five-membered ring, in place of the usual chain.
fact.zh: 它同時在吩坦尼上疊加兩項改動：環上加一個氟原子，並以呋喃環（含氧的五員環）取代原本的鏈狀結構。
fact.zhHans: 它同时在吩坦尼上叠加两项改动：环上加一个氟原子，并以呋喃环（含氧的五员环）取代原本的链状结构。
